items.title: Benjie White Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: when we got into the Roosevelt Hotel, Pinky came in... The original Owls was composed of... and myself.

ctx.x: What did he do on that record, did he play banjo, or guitar?

He played guitar, and he, and Pinky Vedakovich, sang a, a little solo, if you'll notice, on the record. Then another one, that played with us, was, oh, what was that fellow's name? Alfred Galladora. I don't know whether you know, Alfred Galladora, but he played, oh, two or three occasions, with us, at the Southern Yacht Club, when we were spotting. And that was as fine a musician, as I ever, bump up the gifts in my life. I've never met a musician, that could, could transpose, any piece of music, that you put up…
Well, to get back to the very beginning, were your family musical before you?
